info.title: LeeOS Core API
info.description: Single-owner loopback API with strict Host/Origin and bearer checks. Structure 9 adds explicitly authorized, one-use local text job execution, durable reconciliation and owner review. Execution is disabled by default; cloud and external executors remain inactive. Runtime Zod contracts are authoritative. Structure 10 adds default-disabled bounded coordination: UTC once/interval schedules and terminal-run event rules queue runs for owner review only. No cron interpretation, webhook ingestion, inference or job authority is granted by a trigger. Structure 11 adds bounded English draft intake, clarification and owner edits, immutable revisions and exact reviewed-proposal approval into one queued run/plan. Intake uses no model and grants no execution or schedule authority. Structure 12 adds a domain-agnostic browser workbench using these same owner-authenticated endpoints. It introduces no new execution route, database migration or domain-specific automation.
